raw_response:
This small plot is just a corner of my land where I grow other things mixed together — not my main maize field, so the FISP coupons I might get go to the maize plot, not here. I cannot afford to buy fertilizer at market price for this small piece, but I will carry some manure from around the house to help the soil. I will use seed I saved from last year, and my daughters and I will work it ourselves with the hoe — no money for hired hands on such a small piece.
